card.name: Occasional or periodic recurrence phrases
card.fires_on: The last word of phrases meaning now and then, such as 'once in a while', 'from time to time', and the 'ically' in 'Periodically' or 'periodic' before reassess, monitor or evaluate.

modes.label: Periodically reassess
modes.description: The ending 'ically' of 'Periodically' or the word 'periodic' at the start of an instruction to reassess or evaluate patients.

modes.description: The final word of casual phrases for occasional frequency in general web text.
